market_story: MISO's Regulating and Spinning Reserve are synchronised products by BPM-002 definition, and the iron backing them earns its reserve award only in proportion to what one MW of on-line output physically carries in 10-minute deliverable headroom — measured across 5.28M CAMPD online unit-hours at 0.1764 MW/MW (coal 0.14, CC 0.19, CT 0.31, ST 0.29), the same ramp-x-deploy-time capability construction MISO's own SCUC/SCED clears reserves with (BPM-002-r25 SS4.2.1.46-47). Pricing that gate at the measurement instead of an uncited 0.5 guardrail deepens synchronisation opportunity cost in exactly the tight evening hours MISO's own market prices it: the nested market-wide Reg+Spin family now reaches the full published $98 demand-curve step in all three years, and scarce-hour energy prices carry the co-optimised withholding cost the real market's DA clearing shows.
